response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm_difference FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_difference) AS mean_difference FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_difference) AS avg_iga_igm_difference, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_difference / NULLIF(om.mean_difference, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om GROUP BY pa.SEX ORDER BY pa.SEX;
